name: TCHONG
recent: TCHONG 近期公告集中在财务资助事项，以及 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩发布。公司也提交了数项「其他」类公告，但资料未说明具体内容。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 8 月 26 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
公司分别于 2026 年 8 月 26 日及 2026 年 10 月 8 日公告提供财务资助。
risks: 公司两度公告提供财务资助，涉及向其他方提供资金或担保。
公司提交了数项「其他」类公告，具体内容未在资料中说明。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: TCHONG's recent announcements centred on provisions of financial assistance and the release of its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026. It also filed several 'Others' announcements whose details are not specified in the materials.
notable_en: The company released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 on 26 August 2026.
The company announced provisions of financial assistance on 26 August 2026 and 8 October 2026.
risks_en: The company announced provisions of financial assistance twice, involving funding or guarantees extended to other parties.
The company filed several 'Others' announcements whose details are not described in the materials.
